caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP rows label ATCC 16404 as Aspergillus niger, while the primary paper table labels the target as Aspergillus brasiliensis; matched values are preserved as source_conflict rather than silently normalized.
Merged DBAASP sequence rows store core residue strings and often blank peptide names; final identity uses primary Table 1 lipopeptide denotations for fatty-acid chain and C-terminal amide context.
Five local supplementary landing-*.bin files were checked and are HTML landing/support pages, with no recoverable structured supplement table that changes activity, database, or mechanism decisions.
The paper supports MIC/MBC/MFC/HC10 structure-activity conclusions and a TFA comparison; no direct membrane-disruption assay is promoted to direct_mechanism.
